title: New Moon
description: The side facing Earth receives no direct sunlight, making the satellite nearly invisible from our planet.

title: First Quarter
description: Half of the lunar surface is illuminated, creating a D shape in the northern hemisphere.
details: Appears about 7 days after the New Moon

title: Full Moon
description: The entire visible disk is illuminated by sunlight, creating a bright circle in the night sky.
details: Occurs about 14-15 days into the cycle

title: Last Quarter
description: The opposite half becomes visible, forming a C shape in the northern hemisphere.
details: Appears about 21-22 days after the beginning of the cycle
